assessment.match_notes: Task requires dilute (loang) hydrochloric acid in solution. Every real photograph of hydrochloric acid on Wikimedia Commons depicts concentrated acid or is unverifiable: bottle labels read 35% (Kwas solny.jpg, VLM-verified), 33% (Solna kislina.JPG), 30-33% (Danny S. photo), or explicitly 'steczony'/'conc.' (Hydrochloric acid 02.jpg); Hydrochloric acid 04.jpg shows acid fumes on pH paper; Hydrochloric acid lab-style bottles are P.A. reagent grade. The one beaker photo (Hydrochloric acid 01.jpg) has no machine-readable author or source, so provenance is unclear. Hydrochloric acid 30 percent.jpg is described on its own file page as an unlabeled bottle ('a colorless liquid that could be anything'). Using any of these for the dilute HCl node would be scientifically misleading, so the honest result is NO_EXACT_REAL_PHOTO.

fallback_recommendation.reason: Dilute hydrochloric acid is visually a colorless aqueous solution and every Commons photograph shows concentrated grades. A generated solution-context image (colorless liquid in a labeled reagent bottle/beaker) is the honest fallback and avoids misrepresenting concentration.
